description: Does a Tyr at alphaB1 predict class I ligand preference? Per-domain P-2 Ser/Thr enrichment among binders, corrected against each domain's own tested panel, grouped by alphaB1 identity across the measured PDZome
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

cen = pd.read_csv("human_pdzome_alphaB1_census.csv")
cen = cen[cen.aln_score > 10]
cen["key"] = np.where(cen.groupby("gene").gene.transform("size") > 1,
                      cen.gene + "_" + cen.domain_index.astype(str), cen.gene)
look = cen.set_index("key")[["alphaB1_aa","GPhiGPhi","uniprot"]]

df = pd.read_excel(pd.ExcelFile("Gogl2022_SupplementaryData1.xlsx"), "PDZ-PBM interactome",
                   usecols=["PDZ","PBM","peptide","COMP_neglogKd"])
df["pKd"] = pd.to_numeric(df.COMP_neglogKd, errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
pep = df.peptide.astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
df["Pm2"] = pep.str[-3]
df["classI"] = df.Pm2.isin(["S","T"])

rows = []
for d, g in df.groupby("PDZ"):
    if d not in look.index: continue
    b = g[g.pKd > 0]
    n_b, n_t = len(b), len(g)
    if n_b < 10: continue          # need enough binders to estimate a preference
    a, c = b.classI.sum(), n_b - b.classI.sum()          # binders: classI, not
    e, f = g.classI.sum()-a, (n_t-n_b)-c                 # non-binders: classI, not
    or_ = ((a+0.5)*(f+0.5))/((c+0.5)*(e+0.5))            # Haldane-corrected
    p = stats.fisher_exact([[a, c],[max(e,0), max(f,0)]], alternative="greater")[1]
    rows.append(dict(pdz=d, alphaB1=look.loc[d,"alphaB1_aa"], GPhiGPhi=look.loc[d,"GPhiGPhi"],
                     n_tested=n_t, n_binders=n_b, hit_rate=round(n_b/n_t,3),
                     frac_classI_binders=round(b.classI.mean(),3),
                     frac_classI_panel=round(g.classI.mean(),3),
                     log2_OR_classI=round(np.log2(or_),3), fisher_p=p,
                     median_binder_pKd=round(b.pKd.median(),2)))
r = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("log2_OR_classI", ascending=False)
r.to_csv("profaff_alphaB1_vs_classI_preference.csv", index=False)

print(f"domains with alphaB1 assigned and >=10 binders: {len(r)}")
print("\nby alphaB1 residue (log2 OR for S/T at P-2 among binders vs that domain's own panel):")
summ = r.groupby("alphaB1").agg(n_domains=("pdz","size"), median_log2OR=("log2_OR_classI","median"),
        median_hit_rate=("hit_rate","median"), median_frac_classI=("frac_classI_binders","median"))
print(summ.sort_values("median_log2OR", ascending=False).to_string())

H = r[r.alphaB1=="H"].log2_OR_classI; Y = r[r.alphaB1=="Y"].log2_OR_classI
print(f"\nHis-alphaB1 n={len(H)} median log2OR={H.median():.2f}   Tyr-alphaB1 n={len(Y)} median log2OR={Y.median():.2f}")
if len(Y) >= 3:
    u = stats.mannwhitneyu(Y, H, alternative="two-sided")
    print(f"Mann-Whitney Tyr vs His: U={u.statistic:.0f}, p={u.pvalue:.3f}")
print("\nTyr-alphaB1 domains with enough binders to profile:")
print(r[r.alphaB1=="Y"].to_string(index=False))
print("\nHis-alphaB1, one-sided Fisher p<0.05 for class I preference: "
      f"{(r[r.alphaB1=='H'].fisher_p<0.05).sum()}/{len(H)}")
print("Tyr-alphaB1, one-sided Fisher p<0.05 for class I preference: "
      f"{(r[r.alphaB1=='Y'].fisher_p<0.05).sum()}/{len(Y)}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))
order = summ.sort_values("median_log2OR", ascending=False).index.tolist()
order = [a for a in order if (r.alphaB1==a).sum() >= 3]
dat = [r.loc[r.alphaB1==a, "log2_OR_classI"].values for a in order]
bp = ax[0].boxplot(dat, labels=order, showfliers=False, patch_artist=True)
for b_, a_ in zip(bp["boxes"], order):
    b_.set_facecolor("crimson" if a_=="Y" else ("navy" if a_=="H" else "0.8")); b_.set_alpha(.65)
for i, a_ in enumerate(order):
    v = r.loc[r.alphaB1==a_, "log2_OR_classI"].values
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(v), i+1)+np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(v)), v, s=12, c="k", zorder=3)
ax[0].axhline(0, ls="--", c="0.4", lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel("alphaB1 residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("log2 OR, S/T at P-2 among binders")
ax[0].set_title("Tyr-alphaB1 domains prefer class I as strongly as His-alphaB1 domains")

ax[1].scatter(r.frac_classI_panel, r.frac_classI_binders, s=18, c="0.7", edgecolor="none")
sel = r[r.alphaB1=="Y"]
ax[1].scatter(sel.frac_classI_panel, sel.frac_classI_binders, s=55, c="crimson", label="Tyr at alphaB1")
for _, q in sel.iterrows():
    ax[1].annotate(q.pdz, (q.frac_classI_panel, q.frac_classI_binders), xytext=(5,4),
                   textcoords="offset points", fontsize=8, color="crimson")
lim = [0, 1]; ax[1].plot(lim, lim, ls="--", c="0.4", lw=1)
ax[1].set_xlabel("class I fraction of the panel each domain was tested on")
ax[1].set_ylabel("class I fraction of that domain's binders")
ax[1].set_title("Above the diagonal = class I preference"); ax[1].legend(frameon=False, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
